newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes unchanged in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes unchanged in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed unchanged in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 593.37 from 593.33 on Monday.
Trade volume was 400,814 dinars against 190,249 dinars.
BTEI bank was down 0.18 dinar to 22.32 dinars. Airliner Tunis Air eased 0.6 dinar to 19.34 dinars.
Banque de l'Habitat was up 2.19 dinars to 37.65 dinars. BDET bank was up 0.63 dinar to 14.58 dinars.
